description.value:
Ability Scores: DEX, WIS, CHA

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.suns-of-rubi-core.feats.FeatActorOrigin1]{Actor}

Skill Proficiencies: Choose 2 from ACR, INS, PRF, SLT

Feature: By Popular Demand

You can always find a place to perform, whether in a high-end corporate orbital lounge, a packed cantina in a mining town, or a pirate hollow in deep space. At such a place, you receive free lodging and food of a modest or comfortable standard (depending on the quality of the establishment), as long as you perform each evening. In addition, your performance makes you something of a local figure. When strangers recognize you in a town or orbital station where you have performed, they typically take a liking to you.

Roleplay Characteristics

Personality Traits

d6 Trait
1I love a good insult battle, even if it might escalate into a tavern brawl.
2Nobody stays angry at me or around me for long once I turn on the charm.
3I change my holographic hair and vocal presets depending on who I am trying to impress.
4I constantly observe crowd reactions and take notes for my next public composition.
5I treat every social encounter as an improvised stage performance.
6I cannot stand silence; I hum, tap beats, or spin stories whenever things quiet down.

Ideals

d6 Trait
1Beauty. Art and joy are the only things that keep human spirits alive under planetary domes. (Good)
2Tradition. Ancient acoustic ballads and heritage stories must never be forgotten in the digital age. (Lawful)
3Creativity. The world is a blank canvas, and convention is made to be broken. (Chaotic)
4Greed. Holographic fame leads directly to corporate sponsorships and private shuttles. (Evil)
5Honesty. The best art is visceral, raw, and completely unvarnished truth. (Neutral)
6Inspiration. Through song and spectacle, we can ignite planetary revolutions. (Any)

Bonds

d6 Trait
1My instrument or holo-projector is a priceless heirloom from an extinct planetary biosphere.
2I would do anything to protect the members of my traveling performance troupe.
3An Omni-Tek media magnate ruined my career after I refused to sign an exclusive servitude contract.
4My songs keep alive the memories of heroes who perished resisting tyranny.
5A fan once saved my life from an assassin; I will never turn my back on them.
6I seek the lost sonic frequencies rumored to harmonize with Notum fields.

Flaws

d6 Trait
1I crave applause and center-stage attention; I sulk when ignored.
2I am terrible at keeping secrets if they could make for a sensational story.
3I cannot resist a pretty face or someone who flatters my artistic genius.
4I am easily scandalized and insulted by anyone with poor taste.
5My reckless hedonism has left me with debts across half a dozen planetary colonies.
6Underneath my charismatic persona, I am terrified of being forgotten.

advancement.title: Ability Score Improvement
advancement.hint: Your background allows you to increase your DEX, WIS, CHA scores: increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.

advancement.title: Skill Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Choose 2 skills from: acr, ins, prf, slt.

advancement.title: Tool Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Your background grants you tool proficiency options.

advancement.title: Origin Feat
advancement.hint: Your background grants you the Actor origin feat.
